headline: Ravens’ Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens Out For Week 6
summary: Lamar Jackson was out for the Ravens’ Week 5 victory. His ankle injury will require at least one more game out of the lineup. Head coach Jesse Minter announced on Friday (video link) that Jackson will be sidelined once again on Sunday against the Browns. headline: Steelers place Wilson on IR with finger injury
summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

headline: Sean McVay believes the Harrison Mevis blocked field goal would have missed anyway
summary: After Monday night's overtime loss to the Bills, Rams coach Sean McVay minced no words — he said the field goal unit lost the game.

headline: Rams can't seem to fix their special teams
summary: Special teams have played a significant role in five of the Rams' nine losses since the start of last season, including the playoffs.
